description: Kommunales Abwasser - Kommunale Kläranlagen NRW is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by LANUK NRW. In North Rhine-Westphalia, data on municipal wastewater treatment plants with a capacity of 50 p.e. and above are collected by the competent water authorities (district governments, lower water authorities) in the ELKA database (introductory register). Coverage: LANUK NRW. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal wastewater - Municipal wastewater treatment plants NRW" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is LANUK NRW. Its keywords include NRW, kommunale Kläranlagen, opendata, LANUK, Kläranlagentechnik, Abwasser. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
